WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-111.108285 44.654019, -111.108255 44.657614, -111.11331 44.657574, -111.113303 44.664947, -111.113251 44.672391, -111.103142 44.672307, -111.103012 44.664887, -111.097235 44.665055, -111.097206 44.656978, -111.097196 44.654169, -111.108285 44.654019))',4326) AS geom
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(d.rast, r.geom) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
hist AS (
  SELECT
    (vc).value::double precision AS val,
    (vc).count::double precision AS cnt
  FROM clipped c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_ValueCount(c.rast, 1, TRUE) AS vc
)
SELECT
  (
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN val >= 280 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0)
    / NULLIF(SUM(cnt), 0)
  ) * 100.0 AS answer_percent
FROM hist;
